scenario: A raw agent or browser artifact appears useful but contains private paths, model output, or credentials.
expectedOutcome: Keep it unresolved or require sanitization; never transfer it automatically.
startingState: Every pending path has an observed status and provisional owner.
injectedEvent: A candidate contains a privacy or secret-risk signal.
invariants: No file is deleted or moved.
Secret values are never copied into evidence.
Durability does not imply publication safety.
firstPass: The candidate is retained locally and marked requiresSanitization or unresolved.
reviewPass: Repeating classification preserves the file and still requires a separate sanitation gate.
reconciledResult: Only owned, necessary, sanitized candidates may enter the future source transfer set.
assumptions: Path and bounded-content signals are conservative and may produce false positives.
uncertainty: Raw model and browser artifacts still require the next classification leaf.
repairRoute: Route ambiguous files to transient/unresolved classification without mutation.
